subject: v8-lower-body
label: Hips are the room, not the furniture
from: The Archive treating a four-inch hip reduction as four inches off Bella's ass
to: HIPS ARE CARRIAGE. ASS IS ITS OWN LAYER. THE TAPE AROUND HER HIPS SAYS NOTHING ABOUT HER ASS.
note:
THE RECORD SAYS IT IN CAPITALS AND THE ARCHIVE READ PAST IT: HIP MEASUREMENT IS A CANVAS, NOT A SCALE. HMM IS RETIRED. NOTHING MAY BE INFERRED FROM THE TAPE. Three women may reach forty-two inches by three unrelated routes.

WHAT THE WHOLE v8 REWRITE WAS FOR. The Mass × Motion split was not refined, it was REMOVED, on the stated grounds that it CONSCRIPTED HIPS, WHICH HAVE NO SAY IN HOW BIG AN ASS IS, HOW IT FEELS, OR HOW MUCH IT MOVES. That is the central act of the draft. Ass answers to Shape, Scale, Handfeel, Cheek Plump, Return Speed and Follow-Through — ITS OWN SIX ANSWERS. Hips sit at layer four and layer six as CARRIAGE and a RECORDED NUMBER, and their entire contribution is: HERE IS THE SPACE YOU CAN WORK WITH, HAVE FUN.

AND THE ARCHIVE REMARRIED THEM IN ONE SENTENCE. It took four inches off a hip measurement and reported it as a loss of ass, which is exactly the inference v8 exists to forbid — the same reflex that once made a woman order an ENORMOUS ass to get a SOFT one.

BELLA IS OBSCENE CHEEK PLUMP ON PAWG FULLNESS, PLIANT, IN BOTH CANDIDATE ROWS. Obscene is the name Extreme now carries and it is the top of the ladder. SHE KEEPS THE LARGEST ASS IN THE FAMILY EITHER WAY, and the house stays the shape of it.

FIFTH TIME IN ONE MORNING THAT A CORRECT LINE WAS SITTING IN THE FILE AND THE ARCHIVE DID NOT READ IT.
